question: Can I get my money back for a taxi from the airport when travelling for work?
expected_answer_summary: Ground transport between airport and hotel/office is reimbursable; receipt within 30 days; rides over EUR 80 need manager pre-approval.

question: How long do I have to submit receipts after a business trip?
expected_answer_summary: Receipts must be submitted within 30 days of returning from the trip.

question: What do I do on my first day?
expected_answer_summary: Collect laptop and badge from IT, complete the security training, meet your buddy, and set up accounts listed in the onboarding checklist.

question: Who helps a new joiner during the first weeks?
expected_answer_summary: Each new joiner is assigned a buddy for the first 30 days plus a line manager for formal check-ins.

question: How many days off do I get per year?
expected_answer_summary: Employees receive 25 paid vacation days per calendar year, accrued monthly.

question: Can unused holidays roll over to next year?
expected_answer_summary: Up to 5 unused days may be carried into the next year and must be used by 31 March.

question: My laptop is broken, who should I contact?
expected_answer_summary: Raise a ticket in the IT service desk; hardware failures are P2 with a next-business-day replacement.

question: How fast will someone answer an urgent IT ticket?
expected_answer_summary: P1 tickets are acknowledged within 1 hour; P2 within 4 business hours.

question: What rules apply to my account password?
expected_answer_summary: Minimum 14 characters, MFA mandatory, no reuse of the last 5 passwords, password manager required.

question: Am I allowed to store work files on a personal Google Drive?
expected_answer_summary: No. Company data may only be stored in approved corporate storage; personal cloud accounts are prohibited.

question: What has to happen before code goes live?
expected_answer_summary: Code review approval, green CI pipeline, QA sign-off, and a release ticket approved by the release manager.

question: Who can approve a deployment to production?
expected_answer_summary: The release manager, or a delegated tech lead when the release manager is unavailable.

question: Is it fine to work from home permanently?
expected_answer_summary: Hybrid is the default: minimum 2 office days per week; fully remote requires an exception approved by the department head.

question: What should I do if I think data has leaked?
expected_answer_summary: Report to the security team immediately via the incident hotline; do not attempt to investigate or remediate alone.

question: How do I order a second monitor?
expected_answer_summary: Submit an equipment request in the IT service desk; standard peripherals are approved by your line manager.

question: What are the rules for using the company credit card?
expected_answer_summary: The card is for business expenses only; itemised receipts required; personal use must be reimbursed within 14 days.

question: Do I need permission to attend a paid conference?
expected_answer_summary: Yes. Training budget requests require line manager approval; the annual budget per employee is EUR 1500.

question: How is my performance evaluated?
expected_answer_summary: Twice-yearly review cycles with self-assessment, manager assessment, and peer feedback from at least 2 colleagues.

question: What happens if I lose my access badge?
expected_answer_summary: Report the loss to facilities and security the same day; the badge is deactivated and a replacement issued within 2 business days.

question: Which parking spot is assigned to the CEO?
expected_answer_summary: Not covered by the documentation — the assistant must answer that the information is not available rather than inventing it.
